clean_build_yaml: run build-cleaner.py on a build.yaml file to produce a cleaner sorted version
rebuild_as_ordered_dict: rebuild a dictionary as an OrderedDict with special keys prioritized before others
clean_elem: clean a build element dict by sorting proto files before others in headers and src lists
test_cleaned_yaml: set TEST=true env var and run build-cleaner.py to assert output matches input
repr_ordered_dict: register a custom YAML representer for OrderedDict to preserve key ordering in output
